A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of intensive chemotherapy followed by stem cell rescue is a very effective therapy for patients with relapsed/refractory IGL, with the most favorable results observed in those responding to salvage therapy.
the use of autologous transplantation is a reasonable treatment for patients with relapsed IGL who have a complete or partial response to salvage therapy.

the use of autologous stem cell transplantation in the treatment of patients with IGL is a highly effective salvage therapy for patients with IGL that has failed to respond to induction therapy, or who have responded to primary therapy but have failed to respond to salvage therapy.
